create_MeshRCNNMapper: create a MeshRCNNMapper instance with cfg, is_train flag, and dataset_names to apply image and mesh transformations
call_MeshRCNNMapper_transform: transform a dataset_dict by reading the image, applying resize and flip transforms, and preparing instances
build_annotations_to_instances: build an Instances object from annotation dicts containing bboxes, classes, masks, voxels, and meshes
load_unique_meshes: load unique OBJ mesh models from a JSON annotation file and model root directory into memory
process_mesh_transforms: process a mesh by transforming vertices to camera coordinates and applying horizontal flip or resize transforms
